{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if any QA orders (revenue = '999999.99') are in the converted group
qa_orders = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
converted_qa = df.loc[qa_orders, 'converted']

print(f"QA orders: {qa_orders.sum()}")
print(f"Converted QA orders: {converted_qa.sum()}")
print(f"Non-converted QA orders: {converted_qa.count() - converted_qa.sum()}")

# Now check if any QA orders exist at all
print(f"Any QA orders in dataset? {qa_orders.any()}")"}
